items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: This one was with Sonny Payne, we were in Frankfurt... it was over there with a 70 piece symphony band with Odetta as star.

ctx.x: guitar and keep up with him is no picnic.
Did Tatum know that you didn't read music?

Oh yeah. He didn't read music. Nobody read no music. We had no time for no music. I don't know if Slam could read or not, even. Maybe, I really don't know. I know I didn't. Shit, never crossed my mind to read no music. I have faked it quite a few times. I mean faked it too, I faked it in Germany about 5 years ago or 6 years ago --- This one was with Sonny Payne, we were in Frankfurt not Frankfurt -- right next to Frankfurt...
